title: pace-code-e.pdf — section 22
text:
7.5 When the suspect is brought into the interview room, the interviewer shall without
delay and in the sight of the suspect, switch on the recording equipment and enter the
information necessary to log on to the secure network and start recording.

7.6 The interviewer must then inform the suspect that the interview is being recorded
using a secure digital network and that recording has commenced.

7.7 In addition to the requirements of paragraph 4.4 (a – d) above, the interviewer must
inform the person that:
